title: Looking for a Clint Eastwood movie where he is a over the top larger than life character and is a force to be reckoned with

commenti.body: They don’t really fit the bill because it sounds like you want an action hero kind of character, but you might enjoy watching High Plains Drifter and Pale Rider back to back. Both films present him in a not so subtle supernatural light, the latter as something of an avenging angel, the former as something a bit darker. He kicks ass in both needless to say.
